alt.en: At assigned times zero and one, two requests fail and open the breaker. Time two gets fallback without an attempt. At time six a successful probe closes it. The actual HTTP drill uses a shorter cooldown and retains earlier errors in its SLO window.
alt.zh-hans: 给定时间线中，0、1 秒的两个请求失败，使熔断器断开；2 秒直接降级，不再尝试；6 秒探测成功后闭合。实际 HTTP 演练使用更短的冷却，但统计窗口仍保留早先错误。

caption.en: Figure 56.1 — Recovery changes future calls; it does not erase earlier failures.
caption.zh-hans: 图 56.1——恢复改变后续调用，不会抹掉先前失败。

label.en: Assigned clock: two failed requests, five-second cooldown
label.zh-hans: 给定时钟：两次请求失败，冷却五秒

text.zh-hans: 6 秒：一次探测成功 → 闭合

flow.en: Time since opening is 6 − 1 = 5 s. A second half-open probe is blocked while the first is active.
flow.zh-hans: 距断开已过 6 − 1 = 5 秒。半开时，第一次探测尚未结束，不能再放入第二次。

label.en: Actual local HTTP drill: cooldown 0.25 s
label.zh-hans: 实际本地 HTTP 演练：冷却 0.25 秒

text.en: Two failed jobs + open rejection: 3 bad
text.zh-hans: 两个失败任务与一次断开拒绝：3 个坏结果

flow.en: Five eligible jobs: 2 good / 5 = 40%. Earlier errors remain after recovery; this is injected smoke traffic, not production availability.
flow.zh-hans: 五个符合条件的任务：2 个好结果 / 5 = 40%。恢复后仍保留先前错误；这是注入故障的演练流量，不是生产可用性。
